# Kaltrina Ajdini — Architect

> Architect working across public buildings, housing, interiors and cultural heritage — from the first concept through construction documentation and site coordination. Currently freelancing for PIKA 3D, Chicago.

I’m an architect from Prishtina. My goal is always to give better shape to the built environment through beautiful, functional architecture — buildings and interiors that work well for the people who use them.
I studied architecture at the University of Prishtina “Hasan Prishtina” and spent three years at New Dimension Architecture, designing commercial and residential projects with budgets up to €6 million across every phase, from concept to construction documents and on-site supervision. Alongside practice I’ve worked on cultural heritage — documenting and protecting monuments with the Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sport and Cultural Heritage without Borders.
Today I work as a freelance architect for PIKA 3D in Chicago.
I’m detail-oriented, a fast learner and at my best in a team, comfortable juggling several projects at once.

## Current role
- Freelance Architect, PIKA 3D (Chicago, IL)

## Projects
- [Hyatt Regency Chicago](https://www.kaltrinaajdini.com/projects/hyatt-regency-chicago) — Documentation, Chicago, IL: Scan-to-BIM documentation and stone-cap shop drawings for the outdoor plaza of the Hyatt Regency Chicago on East Wacker Drive.
- [200 S Wacker](https://www.kaltrinaajdini.com/projects/200-s-wacker) — Documentation, Chicago, IL: A scan-based documentation and technical coordination study for the exterior plaza of 200 S Wacker in downtown Chicago.
- [Primary School](https://www.kaltrinaajdini.com/projects/primary-school) — Public facility: A school organised around group learning, with shared spaces and an atrium between the classrooms.
- [Olympic Pool](https://www.kaltrinaajdini.com/projects/olympic-pool) — Public facility: A sports centre that pulls the surrounding greenery into the building through long views.
- [Office Building](https://www.kaltrinaajdini.com/projects/office-building) — Public facility: An office building with a rigid urban façade and a second skin of aluminium louvres over a transparent curtain wall.
- [Flexible Housing](https://www.kaltrinaajdini.com/projects/flexible-housing) — Residential: A housing block whose apartments can adapt to the changing needs of the people living in them.
- [Geodes Office](https://www.kaltrinaajdini.com/projects/geodes-office) — Interior design: A green, technologically advanced office interior designed around flexible work and employee well-being.
